news_headlines.title: Despite global disruptions, Royal Caribbean Group says bookings are stronger than last year

The company saw a brief slowdown in bookings for European and Mexican itineraries due to various factors but quickly rebounded, indicating resilient demand for cruise vacations. Royal Caribbean expects continued double-digit revenue and earnings growth, driven by consumer preference for their brands and an expanding portfolio, along with increased onboard spending.

news_headlines.title: Carnival Advances Fuel Procurement Modernization With New Digital Platform

The company chose Inatech’s Shiptech for its comprehensive digital capabilities, aiming to enhance efficiency, control, and visibility in fuel planning and procurement. This move is expected to support Carnival's broader goals including cost management, sustainability, and digital transformation, providing real-time data and insights for smarter fuel decisions.
